text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet doesn't seem to be feeling 
very well...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing. I just have a slight 
headache."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was studying late yesterday... I'm sure 
that's why.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to worry about it. I'll 
take some medicine later, anyway—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah, geez!! This is so frustrating!!

And so, Daiwa Scarlet found herself 
plagued by a headache...
